## Mean and SD

Can we check CLT using simulations

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)

```

Let's do this but keep track of results

```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
  
}
```

inspect results

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

Let's do this using tibbles and map instead!

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

Look at results

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## change `n`

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
   mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```


```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```

Look at the numbers

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  group_by(samp_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

## SLR!!

generate once

```{r}
sim_data = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
    y = 2 + 3 * x + rnorm(30, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  )

sim_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

fit = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data)

fit
```

turn this into a function

(i did that in `source/sim_slr.R`)

```{r}
sim_slr(30)
```

Do this a lot!

```{r}
slr_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

is this right

```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat)) +
  geom_point()
```
